summary: Iter11 — verified domain allowlist for Emergent Google sign-in. Backend: 13/13 pytest green covering _email_domain_allowed pure-function cases (vivofashiongroup, SHOPZETU caps, gmail blocked, evil-shopzetu.com.x blocked, outlook blocked), ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS env override (custom domains + empty disables), regression on invalid session_id -> 401 and missing -> 400, plus seeded manager+associate sessions still authenticate /api/auth/me with roles preserved. Frontend: /login renders cleanly with no banner; /login?error=... renders data-testid='login-error-banner' (red palette rgb(254,242,242)) with 'Sign-in blocked' heading + the detail message. Regression: manager seeded session still loads /dashboard with full sidebar (Today/Overview/Customers/Inbox/Lookbooks/Insights/Cohorts/Operations/Templates/Audit), Hello Test header, KPI strip, call list — no behaviour change.
verified_acceptance_criteria: ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS env override -> set('example.com','foo.io') correctly honoured; empty string disables allowlist (returns True for anything). PASS.
POST /api/auth/session with bad session_id still returns 401 'Invalid session_id'. PASS.
POST /api/auth/session with no session_id returns 400. PASS.
/login (no query) renders data-testid='login-page' without data-testid='login-error-banner'. PASS.
/login?error=<msg> renders data-testid='login-error-banner' with 'Sign-in blocked' heading + the message text in a red banner (red-50 bg, red-200 border, red-800 text, ShieldAlert icon). PASS.

AuthCallback.jsx code path verified by inspection: catch block reads e.response.status===403 + e.response.data.detail and navigates with navigate(`/login?error=${encodeURIComponent(reason)}`). End-to-end 403 reproduction skipped (requires a real non-allowed Emergent session — out of test reach), per agent-to-agent context note.
Regression — manager seeded session loads /dashboard with full sidebar + dashboard content (Test Manager MANAGER badge, KPI strip, call list).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: in /api/auth/session error message construction (server.py L309-313) the f-string assumes the sorted ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS set yields exactly the two intended domains in [first,last] order; with the default set this becomes 'shopzetu.com or vivofashiongroup.com' (alphabetical sort). Renders correctly today but if a 3rd domain is added the message will skip the middle one. Consider joining all domains with ' or ' instead of split[0]/[-1].
Minor: server.py is already 1500+ lines (well past the 700-line guideline) — domain allowlist + auth could split cleanly into /app/backend/auth.py for maintainability.
Nit: FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') triggers DeprecationWarnings (use lifespan handlers). Not introduced by this change, pre-existing.
test_credentials: Used seeded Bearer tokens from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (manager + associate). No new credentials needed.
seed_data_creation: None — only read-only assertions against pre-seeded users + sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Domain allowlist feature shipped & verified. Next agents can rely on test_domain_allowlist.py as regression. End-to-end 403 with a real Google sign-in is not reproducible from inside the testing harness — only unit + login-page error rendering paths can be tested. AuthCallback 403->redirect path is verified by code inspection (Login.jsx + AuthCallback.jsx).
